operatingModel.rule: ChatGPT performs source analysis, designs phases, adjudicates audit findings, and updates this rolling authority. Claude executes repository mutations only from explicit instructions based on this authority.

goal.statement: Produce a complete authoritative SWSE feat corpus with certified identity, descriptions, benefits, prerequisites, source/page provenance, player summaries, semantic tags, implementation provenance, and archetype connections.

rules: Do not infer scope from stale historical audits when this authority has a newer ruling.

Use canonical IDs for identity-sensitive relationships whenever available.
